## 🔍 Code Review & Verification Checklist

### Scientific & Pedagogical Quality
- [ ] **Physical Accuracy**: Scientific formulas, units, and constants match real-world physics.
- [ ] **Curriculum Schema**: Lessons follow the 10-step pedagogical progression with valid misconceptions and inquiries.
- [ ] **Interactive Guardrails**: Sliders and parameter inputs have realistic physical boundaries.

### Technical & Accessibility Standards
- [ ] **TypeScript Check**: `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors.
- [ ] **Lint Quality**: `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- [ ] **Master Audits**: `npm test` executes and passes all 5 verification suites.
- [ ] **WCAG Contrast**: Color tokens and text contrast meet or exceed 4.5:1 ratio.
- [ ] **Zero-Data Privacy**: No student telemetry, remote logging, or tracking introduced.
